evidence.reading: docs/design/testing-architecture.md section 5.1 states one deterministic homing rule: inline below ~500 test-LOC or ~40 test fns, extracted to a sibling tests.rs above it, 'no more intra-directory coin-flip'. Eight files in the 5a manifest sit above that threshold with no sibling: policy_load.rs (2,851 test-LOC / 74 test fns), policy_export.rs (2,257 / 40), stochastic/noise.rs (2,153 / 30), policy/reconcile.rs (1,501 / 60), setup/node_graph.rs (1,464 / 40), setup/stochastic_pipeline.rs (1,332 / 9), setup/bucket_topology.rs (880 / 21), setup/scenario_libraries.rs (727 / 8). The single file that DID get a sibling is setup/mod.rs, which has the fewest inline test fns in the whole manifest (7) and simultaneously declares three test homes: `mod tests;` at L2804 (the 10,356-line setup/tests.rs, 126 test fns), `mod post_study_resolution_tests` at L2807 (6 test fns), and `mod transit_seed_round_trip_tests` at L2963 (1 test fn spanning ~297 lines with 4 local fixture builders). So the rule is applied backwards: extraction went to the lightest file, and the four heaviest inline blocks in the crate stayed inline. setup/tests.rs is the catch-all this produced: it holds the only tests for setup/node_graph.rs::enumerated_scenario_count (asserted at setup/tests.rs:9508 and :9519) even though node_graph.rs has its own 1,464-line inline tests module, and it re-homes the bucket-topology fixture family as a bucket_seed_* prefix family at L9957-L10083.

candidates.fixShape: Apply the section 5.1 threshold per file instead of per directory, in two moves. First, collapse setup/mod.rs to one test home by folding post_study_resolution_tests and transit_seed_round_trip_tests into the existing setup/tests.rs sibling, which already imports crate::test_support at L9. Second, extract the four inline modules furthest above the threshold (policy_load.rs, policy_export.rs, policy/reconcile.rs, setup/node_graph.rs) to sibling tests.rs files, and relocate the node_graph-owned assertions out of the setup/tests.rs catch-all into the node_graph sibling so each production module has exactly one test home. Byte-neutral by construction: moving a test fn between an inline module and a sibling module declared by the same parent changes no production symbol, no assertion and no fixture value, so the reproducibility and declaration-order-invariance harness, the parity goldens and the rank-invariance map are all untouched and no golden moves. Touches no pinned contract in .claude/rules/sddp.md.
